uncertainty.method: PGDA product 78 LDEM clones (Barker et al. 2021, PSS 203:105119) as the innermost 5 m terrain tier within +-2 km; outer tiers unchanged. Each clone event is matched to the baseline event of the same kind inside that event's own slot (halfway to the neighbouring baseline events, max 72 h); percentiles over matched clones; present_frac = share of clones in which the event exists at all.
uncertainty.scope_note: Captures height error within ~2 km of the site; distant-ridge error is not sampled.
